items.title: Peter Erskine interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 9, 2020
items.q: Peter Erskine has performed and recorded with a lengthy list of ensembles and solo artists including the big bands of Stan Kenton and Bob Mintzer

ctx.x: Drummer Peter Erskine has performed and recorded with a lengthy list of ensembles and solo artists including the big bands of Stan Kenton and Bob Mintzer, Maynard Ferguson, Weather Report, Steely Dan, and Joni Mitchell.

Over the years he has won two Grammys and been voted “Best Jazz Drummer of the Year” ten times by Modern Drummer magazine. During this interview he reminisced about his career and the important musical lessons learned along the way.
